task_description: Build a full-stack QuantFeed application - an AI-powered news analysis platform that visualizes economic relationships as a neural network graph. Features news aggregation from Indian and international sources, AI summarization, economic pathway analysis from micro to macro economics, and interactive pathway simulation. Built with Next.js 14 for Vercel deployment.

verification.summary: npm run build generates all 5 static pages and 7 API routes successfully. npm run lint passes with zero errors. No test suite configured (greenfield MVP). No Dockerfile present.
